description_en: Configures a warm pool for a scaling group. If the scaling group does not have a warm pool, this operation creates one. If the scaling group already has a warm pool, this operation modifies the configuration of the warm pool
description_zh: 为伸缩组配置预热池，当伸缩组当前没有预热池时调用此Open API为伸缩组创建预热池，当伸缩组当前有预热池时调用此Open API为伸缩组修改预热池的配置信息
name: PutWarmPool

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate the value from your client. Make sure that the value is unique across different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The expected number of prepared instances. The system maintains the sum of the current number of instances in the scaling group and the number of instances in the warm pool at this value. Instances that exceed the current number of instances in the scaling group are scaled out into the warm pool in advance. This allows rapid scale-out from the warm pool when traffic peaks occur, avoiding the wait time caused by creating instances on the fly.

Default value: the maximum number of instances in the scaling group, which is specified by `MaxSize`.

The value of `DesiredGroupPreparedCapacity` must be less than or equal to the maximum number of instances in the scaling group, which is specified by `MaxSize`
fields.help_zh:
期望预热覆盖实例数。系统会维持伸缩组当前实例数与预热池实例数之和为该值。超出伸缩组当前实例数的部分，将提前扩容进入预热池备用，流量高峰到来时可快速从预热池扩容，避免临时创建实例带来的等待。

默认值为伸缩组的最大实例数`MaxSize`。

`DesiredGroupPreparedCapacity` 的值必须小于或等于伸缩组的最大实例数 `MaxSize`
fields.name: desired_group_prepared_capacity

fields.help_en:
The minimum number of instances in the warm pool. The system always keeps at least this number of warmed instances in the warm pool to ensure rapid scale-out from the warm pool at any time.

Default value: 0.

The value of `MinCapacity` must be less than or equal to the value of `DesiredGroupPreparedCapacity`
fields.help_zh:
预热池最小实例数。系统会始终在预热池中保留不低于该数量的预热实例，保障伸缩扩容时随时可从预热池快速扩容。

默认值为 0。

`MinCapacity` 的值必须小于或等于 `DesiredGroupPreparedCapacity` 的值
fields.name: min_capacity

parameters.help_en: The capacity options for the warm pool
parameters.name: capacity_options

parameters.help_en:
The state of instances in the warm pool. Valid values:

Running: The instances are in the running state. This state enables faster scale-out, but you are charged the full cost of the instances.

Stopped: The instances are in the economical mode. You are charged only for resources such as cloud disks, elastic IP addresses (EIPs), and snapshots of the instances. However, instance startup may fail during scale-out due to insufficient inventory
parameters.help_zh:
预热池中实例的状态。取值范围：

Running：运行中状态，扩容速度更快，但您需要承担实例完整的费用。

Stopped：节省停机状态，您只需要承担实例的云盘、弹性公网 IP（EIP）、快照等资源费用，但伸缩组扩容时可能由于库存不足原因实例启动失败
parameters.name: pool_state

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether instances are reclaimed to the warm pool when the scaling group scales in. Valid values:

true: Instances are reclaimed to the warm pool.

false: Instances are not reclaimed to the warm pool.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
伸缩组缩容时，实例是否重新回收到预热池中。取值范围：

true：实例回收到预热池；

false：实例不回收到预热池。

默认值：false
fields.name: reuse_on_scale_in
